pages.text: $(l)Enchantment Library$()$(li)Use the Enchantment Library to mass-enchant items efficiently$(li)You can add unlimited enchantments of any type to a single item
$(li)Max enchantment level equals the highest-level book you insert

$(l)Dragon Combat$()$(li)Prioritize speed over raw damage when fighting dragons$(li)Fast weapons like shurikens deal more effective damage per second$(li)Use shurikens made of dragon bone, enderium, fluxed electrum, or terrasteel for best results
